descriptions.preferred: 奶油桃子又可称为蜜桃奶盖， 由澳大利亚的育种家Arnold Teese 于 1976 年选择了该品种 ，经过几年的观察培育 并推广 ，叶子有 5 到 7 裂，叶裂深至基部。春天 初芽带白色绒毛，春叶以 黄粉色 为主 ，带有明显的绿色脉纹。夏季会变成绿白色，秋天是黄色的。奶油桃子色彩丰富多变，抗性也非常好，可全日照，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年树高可达 3 米左右。

rhs.description: A deciduous, round-headed tree or shrub to 4m tall and wide. Its deeply-divided and lobed leaves emerge in spring creamy-white with green veins and the tips and margins tinged a pinkish-red. This pinkish-red colouring fades as the leaves mature in summer before turning yellow-orange in autumn. Small purple-red flowers may be followed by winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Hedging/Screens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or by softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 奶油桃子又可称为蜜桃奶盖， 由澳大利亚的育种家Arnold Teese 于 1976 年选择了该品种 ，经过几年的观察培育 并推广 ，叶子有 5 到 7 裂，叶裂深至基部。春天 初芽带白色绒毛，春叶以 黄粉色 为主 ，带有明显的绿色脉纹。夏季会变成绿白色，秋天是黄色的。奶油桃子色彩丰富多变，抗性也非常好，可全日照，夏季午后适当遮阴，成年树高可达 3 米左右。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 低养护，适合坡岸与斜坡，城市/庭院花园，乡村式/自然式花园，花境与花坛，绿篱/屏障栽植

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶圆头形小乔木或灌木，高和冠幅均可达 4 m。其深裂叶于春季萌发时呈乳白色，叶脉为绿色，叶尖和叶缘带粉红红色。随着夏季叶片成熟，这种粉红红色会逐渐褪去，秋季则转为黄橙色。小型紫红色花后，秋季可能结出翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫁接或嫩枝扦插繁殖
